title: Server Components render ahead of time

slides.say: Server Components render ahead of time, before bundling, in an environment separate from your client app.
They can be async and await in render. This one reads a file. It can run once at build time, or per request on a server.

slides.text: The client only gets the output, not the component or its heavy libraries.
slides.say: The browser never downloads this component or its markdown libraries. It only receives the rendered output.

slides.text: No useState here. And there is no "use server" for them.
slides.say: They cannot use interactive APIs like use state. And note: there is no directive for Server Components. Use server is for Server Functions.
